label: Exceeded-god rival of God's maximality in being survives, checked (inference)
meaning: Rival test for God's maximality in being against its smallest consumer, StageTwo.GodIsSimple.godIsSimple (premises: whatever is God is maximal in being, every composite has a uniting cause of its esse, a cause of a quality in another is more such). With a composite god whose uniting cause is more in being and is not God, the exceeded-god rival holds with the other two premises and God is composite. Model-witnessed survival only; it does not show that the name God is correctly applied to such a being.
